info.title: SnowLuma OneBot HTTP API
info.description: OneBot v11-compatible HTTP API generated from catalog.json (200 actions). POST `/{action}` with a JSON body. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `?access_token=<token>` when a token is configured. Every response is a OneBot envelope: `status`, `retcode`, `data`.
